g-005.translation:
Commander Su, why did the Imperial Guard
suddenly change its watch tonight?

g-006.translation: A-Wu, I'm going out tonight. Don't follow.

g-001.translation:
Lin Wan'er, would you really turn on me
over some jianghu drifter?

g-003.translation:
Chancellor Lin, if this gets out,
you may lose your post.

g-008.translation:
Your Majesty, Consort Liu had this tea
prepared specially for you.

g-007.translation:
Senior Brother, I've reached the seventh
level of the Flowing Cloud Sword Art.

g-002.translation: Shen Qi's sword only leaves the sheath once.

g-004.translation: Xiao Jingheng, you thwart me at every turn.\nWhat do you want?

g-009.translation: Miss, the Wild Goose Tower isn't for you.

g-010.translation: Three years I waited in Chang'an.\nAnd now you're back.

g-015.translation: Tianji Pavilion's intel is never wrong.

g-011.translation: Eastern Palace lamps will burn till dawn, I fear.

g-012.translation:
Something's stirring at the Western Hills.
The Imperial Guard has already set out.

g-013.translation: Not just anyone may tread the Lin door.

g-014.translation:
Thirty li out from Baiyu Pass,
scouts report strange movement.

g-016.translation: Mirror Bureau men crept into the Lin Residence.

g-021.translation:
Miss Lin, does your father know
you're looking into this?

g-018.translation: Qingshuang is drawn only to draw blood.

g-017.translation:
The tiger tally isn't with the Crown Prince.
Then who took it?

g-019.translation:
If the Chang'an Scroll falls to the Second Prince,
the realm will descend into chaos.

g-020.translation: Lantern Festival night, all on the wall must die.

g-024.translation: Jingxing, word from the Eastern Palace?

g-023.translation: Bai Yu, you heard nothing. Understand?

g-022.translation: No one in the jianghu dares deny Shen Qi.

g-026.translation:
Commander Su, send another squad
to the Western Hills.

g-025.translation: Shen Qi, the Tianji Pavilion is onto us here.

g-031.translation: The Second Prince is reaching too far.

g-029.translation:
A lifetime of peace is nothing
next to one night in Chang'an with you.

g-030.translation: Pawn the jade hairpin. We need the silver.

g-027.translation:
The Pavilion Master's orders:
the Chang'an Scroll must be
retrieved from Wild Goose Tower.

g-028.translation: Senior Brother said he taught the Flowing Cloud Sword Art to me alone.

g-032.translation:
The Imperial Guard has surrounded the Lin Residence.
Is Chancellor Lin still not coming out?

g-034.translation: The tiger tally is mine. Who dares move?

g-036.translation:
What happened at Wild Goose Tower
that night of the Lantern Festival?

g-038.translation:
Miss Lin, Master Xiao has been waiting
for you in the Eastern Palace for a while.

g-035.translation: Baiyu Pass sent urgent word last night.

g-033.translation: Mirror Bureau business. All stand back.

g-037.translation:
The autumn hunt nears.
The Second Prince begs to ride along.

g-040.translation: Heaven's secrets can't be told. You know.

g-039.translation: Is Shen Qi's Flowing Cloud Sword unbeatable?

g-043.translation:
"Peace year after year"—such pretty words.
Too bad she can't hear them anymore.

g-042.translation:
Brother Su, these Imperial Guards
answer only to your command.

g-041.translation:
Your Majesty, Uncle Chen asks to see you.
Something's happened at the Lin Residence.

g-044.translation: No Scroll, no peace in Chang'an.

g-045.translation:
If you want information, Miss,
Wild Goose Tower is the place.

g-046.translation:
Shen Qi, the Pavilion Master wants you.
He says there's a mole in the Pavilion.

g-047.translation: Senior Brother, Master wants you at Tianji.

g-048.translation:
Senior Brother, three years of the Flowing Cloud
Sword Art, and I still can't get the hang of it.

g-051.translation: Senior Brother, the Second Prince's men are in the city.

g-049.translation:
Senior Brother, a sedan chair just arrived.
Looks like it's bound for the Eastern Palace.

g-050.translation: Senior Brother, get him out.\nI'll hold them off.

g-053.translation: Senior Brother, did the Imperial Guard do this?

g-052.translation:
Senior Brother, the Pavilion Master
ordered: the Chang'an Scroll mustn't
fall into other hands.

g-054.translation:
Your Highness, Baiyu Pass is just ahead.
Please change horses.

g-056.translation:
Your Highness, Commander Su is here.
He says he has something urgent to report.

g-055.translation: Your Highness, I've learned the truth of that night.

g-057.translation:
Your Highness, if you go to the Western Hills,
no one will guard the Eastern Palace.

g-060.translation:
Your Highness, Uncle Chen sent word.
Trouble at the Lin Residence today.

g-058.translation: Your Highness, best you hold the tiger tally.

g-059.translation: Your Highness, the Second Prince\nhas waited outside for half an hour.

g-061.translation: Your Majesty, is Consort Liu better today?

g-063.translation:
Your Majesty, the Mirror Bureau came into
the palace last night. Did you know?

g-062.translation: Your Majesty, the Second Prince is here to pay respects.

g-067.translation:
Your Majesty, the Tianji Pavilion
likely knows what we're planning.

g-069.translation:
Miss, Uncle Chen says the carriage
is ready at the back gate.

g-071.translation:
Miss, the Chancellor wants you
at the front hall tomorrow.

g-064.translation:
Calm yourself, Your Majesty.
Bai Yu is just a songstress, nothing more.

g-068.translation: Miss, I've wiped your Qingshuang clean.

g-070.translation:
Miss, word from Wild Goose Tower:
Lord Xiao goes there tonight.

g-066.translation:
Your Majesty, the autumn hunt list is ready.
Please take a look.

g-072.translation:
Miss, a man outside calls himself Shen Qi.
He says he's been sent to protect you.

g-073.translation:
Miss, word from Baiyu Pass has arrived.
The master is raging in his study.

g-074.translation:
Miss, the Lantern Festival is crowded.
Please stay close to me.

g-077.translation:
Wan'er, the Crown Prince comes to the Lin
Residence tonight. Go change your clothes.

g-075.translation: Miss, the Mirror Bureau is onto the Lins. What now?

g-078.translation:
Commander Su, movement in the Western Hills.
The Guard must stand watch all night.

g-076.translation: Miss, if Consort Liu hears this, we're done for.

g-079.translation: Consort Liu orders: the Second Prince\nmay not enter the Eastern Palace\ntonight.

g-082.translation:
A-Wu, fetch the Qingshuang Sword.
I'm going to Wild Goose Tower.

g-080.translation:
The Pavilion Master said
the Tianji Pavilion won't take
the Chang'an Scroll case.

g-081.translation: Jingxing, who taught you the Flowing Cloud Sword Art?

g-084.translation:
Senior Brother, who really leads
the Tianji Pavilion?

g-086.translation:
Miss, Wild Goose Tower is just ahead.
Bai Yu is waiting for you upstairs.

g-083.translation:
On Lantern Festival night,
an urgent report from Baiyu Pass
reached the Mirror Bureau.

g-085.translation:
Your Highness, the tiger tally is not in
the Eastern Palace. I fear it's already
in the Second Prince's hands.

g-087.translation:
The autumn hunt nears. The Imperial Guard
goes with the Crown Prince to the Western Hills.

g-088.translation: Shen Qi, the man in black with the Second Prince—any luck?

g-090.translation: Chancellor Lin, if the Scroll is in your house, you're implicated.

g-093.translation:
Uncle Chen, ready the carriage.
I'm going to the Tianji Pavilion.

g-089.translation: Brother Su, the Mirror Bureau's here in Chang'an.

g-092.translation:
Rest easy, Senior Brother. I only used
thirty percent of the Flowing Cloud Sword Art.

g-091.translation: Wan'er, this jade hairpin—the Crown Prince's gift?

g-098.translation:
Jingheng, did your mother Consort Liu
ever mention the Chang'an Scroll?

g-094.translation:
Calm yourself, Your Majesty. The Second
Prince only went hunting in the Western Hills.

g-095.translation:
Bai Yu, tonight's guest at Wild Goose Tower
is from the Lin family.

g-100.translation:
Miss Lin, that Lantern Festival night,
did you see anyone from Baiyu Pass?

g-096.translation:
A-Wu, your lady's Qingshuang Sword
is faster than my blade.

g-101.translation: Uncle Chen, no one gets in tonight.

g-097.translation:
Commander Su, whoever holds the tiger
tally commands the Imperial Guard.

g-099.translation:
Your Highness, Mirror Bureau men
have been outside the Eastern Palace all night.

g-103.translation:
Miss, wait. Bai Yu says Wild Goose Tower
doesn't serve the Imperial Guard.

g-106.translation: My mother left me this white jade hairpin.

g-102.translation:
Senior Brother, the Pavilion Master says
heaven's secrets must not be revealed.
But I'll look into it anyway.

g-105.translation: Heaven's secrets stay hidden. Ask no more.

g-109.translation:
Look at this white jade bracelet.
The quality's quite good, actually.

g-107.translation: Frost everywhere, and it's not even dawn.

g-108.translation: Peace year after year—the people's greatest wish.

g-104.translation: May you be safe—I'll stay by your side.

g-112.translation: May Great Ming know peace for all time.

g-110.translation: Heaven's ways are deep—mortals can't grasp them.

g-117.translation: Heavy rain like this is rare in Chang'an.

g-111.translation: Frost on the tiles at dawn, cold to the bone

g-114.translation: The Master says fate can't be forced.

g-116.translation: This is Heaven's will. It can't be told.

g-113.translation: That jade pendant—from beyond the pass?

g-115.translation: White jade floors—you fear to dirty them.

g-118.translation: Her white jade hairpin fell and shattered.

g-119.translation: The frost hasn't melted. Watch your step.

g-122.translation:
Heaven's will is hard to read.
No one can say what tomorrow holds.

g-125.translation: Frost coats the window like thin snow.

g-121.translation: That jade screen was a gift from the palace.

g-124.translation: The white jade piece clicks on the board.

g-120.translation: I only wish for lasting peace. No more.

g-123.translation: Thirty li from Chang'an, a ruined temple.

g-126.translation: Leaking heaven's secrets costs you life.

g-127.translation: That white jade flute melts every heart.

g-132.translation: May peace go with you all the way.

g-133.translation: This white jade cup holds poisoned wine.

g-134.translation: Heaven's will is fixed. Why fight it?

g-128.translation: Chang'an's moon is brighter than elsewhere.

g-138.translation: Is that a new dress? The color suits you.

g-136.translation:
Drink this porridge first.
It won't taste good cold.

g-129.translation: Fate has stirred. We're all pawns in play.

g-137.translation:
It rained so hard last night.
I didn't even shut my window tight.

g-130.translation: He knelt all night on the white jade steps.

g-135.translation: Jade halls, gold horses—all just a dream.

g-140.translation: You look a bit pale. Did you sleep badly?

g-139.translation: Don't stand at the door. Come in and sit.

g-141.translation: Soup's still warm on the stove. Want some?

g-143.translation: Everything's packed. I leave at dawn.

g-146.translation:
Thunder scared me most as a kid.
Not anymore, though.

g-147.translation: When you smile, your eyes curve.

g-144.translation: You rest. I'll take care of the rest.

g-145.translation:
The tree in the yard is blooming
especially well this year.

g-142.translation: Say that to me, fine, but don't spread it.

g-148.translation: Don't rush off. I'm not finished.

g-155.translation: I'm hungry. Do you have any food left?

g-152.translation: My mother said: always leave some room.

g-150.translation: Your old cloak was torn. I mended it.

g-151.translation: So crowded today. I lost my shoe.

g-149.translation: This brew is bitter. I got you sweets.

g-153.translation: Stop fretting over me. I know what I'm at.

g-156.translation:
I hear the neighbors had a baby boy.
Quite the fuss they're making.

g-158.translation:
I'll come get you first thing tomorrow.
Don't oversleep.

g-154.translation: Why's it so cold? Where's the brazier?

g-157.translation: If you're tired, lean on me and rest.

g-159.translation: That was harsh. Don't take it to heart.

g-164.translation: You go on ahead. I'll be right there.

g-162.translation: It's cold. Wear an extra layer out there.

g-161.translation: Don't look at me. My face says nothing.

g-166.translation: Look at the moon—round as a plate.

g-163.translation:
I'm not good with words.
Sweet talk isn't my thing.

g-160.translation: Searched half a day—it was in my hands all along.

g-165.translation: Not your fault. I didn't think it through.

g-167.translation:
I saved up some money.
I want to buy you a new pair.

g-168.translation:
Your Highness, the Imperial Guard
have waited at Xuanwu Gate two hours.

g-170.translation:
Yuer, that gentleman downstairs
requested a song. Do you know it?

g-169.translation:
Seventh Brother, word from the Tianji
Pavilion—the Master wants to see you tonight.

g-172.translation:
Your Highness, the Mirror Bureau
has caught wind of your shipment.

g-171.translation: Commander Su, no soldier at the Western Hills camp moves tonight.

g-173.translation:
Miss, this white jade hairpin is superb.
Want to try it?

g-174.translation: Jingxing, you'd really give the tally to Lin?

g-175.translation:
Your Majesty, the Second Prince isn't home tonight.
My men can't find where he went.

g-176.translation:
Qi, that's the Flowing Cloud Sword Art.
No common fighter uses that.

g-177.translation:
Miss Lin, someone at the gate left a note.
It only says "the Lantern Festival."

g-181.translation: Wan'er, whose blood is this on Qingshuang?

g-179.translation:
Your Highness, the Mirror Bureau
has entered Chang'an.

g-178.translation: Bai Yu, listen. He said Baiyu Pass.

g-180.translation:
Qi, what the Pavilion Master asked you to check—
is it about the Chang'an Scroll?

g-185.translation:
Miss, word from Wild Goose Tower:
a guest of honor tonight.

g-182.translation:
Second Prince, the Crown Prince has the tiger tally.
Why haven't you struck?

g-188.translation:
Wan'er, wear this white jade hairpin.
Don't let anyone recognize you.

g-183.translation: Su Feng, any change to the Guard's watch tonight?

g-184.translation: Senior Brother, "heaven's secrets must not be told" — you buy that?

g-187.translation:
Jingheng, your brother is waiting at the Eastern
Palace. You must go today.

g-186.translation: Your Highness, the Second Prince is on it.

g-191.translation:
Senior Brother, if the Pavilion Master
really is that man, what do we do?

g-190.translation: Your Highness, dare I ask—do you trust her?

g-189.translation: Shen Qi, his last words: Western Hills.

g-192.translation:
Your Majesty, the Imperial Guard
has surrounded the Lin Residence.
